title: STA314
text:
Course Information
All information can be found in the Syllabus.
Just a few important points: - to email me, email sta314@course.utoronto.ca - I will not respond to emails sent to my individual account - all lectures, tutorials, and tests will be delivered in person, unless otherwise specified - there will be one midterm test scheduled during the scheduled class time, and we will have a FAS proctored final examination - the textbook we will be using this term is the Introduction to Statistical Learning by James et al.

title: STA314
text:
Computing
Statistical programming is an essential part of this course. We will use R throughout this course, which is a free, open-source statistical programming language widely used for data analysis and reproducible research.
The software is publicly available for free at https://mirror.csclub.uwaterloo.ca/CRAN/, and it is also highly recommended to install RStudio (https://posit.co/downloads/) for an interactive programming environment. Note that the University of Toronto offers an open-source web application to use R and RStudio: https://r.datatools.utoronto.ca/.
